item.title: [threat-intel] Chinese Nexus Actors Shift Focus to Qatar Amid Iranian Conflict
item.description: Two attacks on Qatari entities signal a shift in focus for China-backed actors and demonstrate how quickly they can pivot in response to geopolitical events.

item.title: [threat-intel] Tentacles of ‘0ktapus’ Threat Group Victimize 130 Firms
item.description: Over 130 companies tangled in sprawling phishing campaign that spoofed a multi-factor authentication system.
